brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: 3 bases (0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0) forming compact cluster with notch drawer frame hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at 1,1,0 (notch:0#1,1#notch2) - drawer frame in notch position where two bases meet, serving as desk drawer unit

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet to hold small platform
requirements.evidence: Spike mount variant at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0) with platform-sm accessory - positioned exactly where the three bases meet

finish.summary: Built compact 3-base cluster with notch drawer frame providing drawer function and mount spike with small platform at the central junction where all three bases meet. Mesh clash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
